scope: Ten ordinary brace length and pattern contracts through four aliases compare GNU output, exit status and file effects. Scalar, indexed/associative array and positional values cover owned versus borrowed inputs. Unset-variable diagnostics and EXIT from nested substitution must release abandoned caller allocations while preserving GNU state. All process logs remain recorded.
